title: Maps from a finite-presentation module extend across a qc open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $U\subseteq X$ be a quasi-compact open subscheme, let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_U$-module of finite presentation (locally the cokernel of a map $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}$ with $m,n$ finite), and let $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F|_U$ be $\mathcal O_U$-linear. Then there are a finite-presentation $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G'$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\varphi':\mathcal G'\to\mathcal F$, together with an isomorphism $\mathcal G'|_U\cong\mathcal G$ under which $\varphi'|_U$ equals $\varphi$.
